name: popup-step
description: One numbered step of a long popup body: a 56px head (numbered title at half opacity, optional text button) over a body that holds the step's control.

props.name: action
props.description: Label of the head's text button (e.g. Reset the selection); omitted when absent.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Makes the step an accordion section: clicking the head (or Enter / Space on the title) shows or hides the body.

props.name: collapsed
props.description: With collapsible: the step starts closed.

props.name: note
props.description: A .ds-popup-step__note in the head, right after the title: a short remark in text-inactive ("No images in this section"); hidden while it has nothing to say.

rationale: The head is 56px (spacing.9 + spacing.5) with 20px side padding, no border and no fill: the popup surface shows through, and steps are separated by their own heads, not by rules. The title is an ordered list with start=N and one item, so the number is real list numbering; the 24px inline-start margin (spacing.7) makes room for it, and the title uses the "title" role at half opacity, like a pane title. The body is inset spacing.cell (10px) / spacing.6 (20px). A .ds-dropdown directly inside a step fills the width. The head's text button hugs its label (see text-button). Rendering verified in light and dark themes. Collapsible (2026-10-12): the head toggles the body that follows it (data-collapsed on the head, so markup stays two siblings); the body animates height over 150ms and is hidden from focus and assistive tech when closed; the open step's title goes to full opacity. window.dsPopupStep.setOpen() lets a host open or close steps from code. Update 2026-10-24 (explicit request): the accordion arrow takes the title's text colour instead of accent-1, so it reads as part of the title; a head may carry a note right after the title in text-inactive body text, for a step that has nothing to choose. A closed step's arrow takes its title's half opacity (grey), an open step's is full (black); the head's text button shows only while the step is open, since it acts on the body (explicit request 2026-10-24).
a11y_notes: Each title is an <ol> with a single <li> so screen readers announce the step number. The head button is a real text-button. Collapsible steps: the title's <li> becomes role=button with aria-expanded and aria-controls, reachable by Tab, toggled by Enter / Space; a closed body is visibility:hidden.
